evals.prompt: I'm a designer mocking up our marketing site. Create a testimonials section as HTML — three cards, each with an avatar, the quote, the person's name and their role. I'm going to convert it into Figma components using the html-to-figma tool in this repo, so structure it accordingly. Save it as testimonials.html in the output directory I give you.
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML file with three testimonial cards marked data-figma-component (non-nested), flexbox layout, Figma-safe fonts/styles, inline-SVG or data-URI imagery; converts via the CLI into the expected components with the mock run passing.

evals.prompt: hey can you make me an html file with a site navbar: logo on the left, 4 nav links in the middle, and a Sign up button on the right. i'll import it into figma as components with this repo's tool. save it as navbar.html in the output directory i give you
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML navbar using flexbox with marked component(s) at one granularity (no nested marks), safe styles, Figma-available font stack; CLI conversion lists sensible components and the mock run passes.
